nom: Kopari Beauty Ceramide & Retinol Dual-Core Eye Balm

avis.texte: I liked this a lot, and love most kopari products! However this was used up in 1 month. Too expensive to go through it so quickly, but I'd keep it in a travel bag for ease of use.
This really didn't do anything for me. It was quite oily. I almost felt like it was a lip balm for your undereyes. Not really worth it for the price. I returned it.
It made my eyes burn so bad that after 2 attempts I will not be using again.

Probably nobody notices but me, but my larger under eye wrinkles looked visibly shallower, like 2 days in. The smaller lines softened also. It didn't take them away but at over a week they seem less pronounced.
I prefer a rich cream but this product works equally well and is far more portable.

Came into the store, not looking to buy any kind of eye cream.I did not have any makeup on today. Tried this ice cream and I fell in love. So moisturizing and easy to take anywhere. I ended up coming home with it and I'm super excited to use it. Will post another review in a few weeks.
this is hydrating and it depends the area under my eyes. its great
Amazing eye balm. Creamy formula glides on smoothly and smooths out my fine lines. My eye area feels so hydrated and my under eye eye corrector is so much easier to apply.
So easy to use and applies smoothly, brightening the whole eye area up. I was concerned it might be caky and accentuate wrinkles, but that's not the case at all.

avis.titre: Ceramide & Retinol Dual core Eye Balm
avis.texte: I have really enjoyed using this product. Makes the dark circles dissappear. Kind of expensive for what you get. Please lower the price or put on sale. Maybe give more product. I do see a difference under my eyes and very soft.
This eye balm goes on easy and I've noticed a difference in my skin under the eyes and laugh lines. Very pleased with this product and will continue to use it.
It goes on smooth, has no sent and so far seems like its doing its job! I will definitely order again!

I've been using this product for a couple weeks now and so far so great! I have had issues with retinol in the past, i.e. redness and dry patches. So far I haven't noticed either. I don't notice a huge difference in the darkness under my eyes, but not many products have been able to help that. The product feels luxurious going on, think and creamy, but no residue or stickiness. Highly recommend to anyone who's skin is okay with retinol, as it can potentially bother different skin types.
I've never found an eye cream that I've been impressed with. Until now. I love the delivery system (in a tube) and It's super moisturizing.

This balm is effortless! Love the stick application. Glides on easily, hydrating and not heavy on the eyes. Skin looked and felt moisturized and refreshed. After several uses, I had no issues with my sensitive skin. Will repurchase!

This is really gentle and moisturizing, and It's easy to use because it comes in the form of a stick. That's my favorite part. I also like that Doesn't irritate my skin. I received this gifted by Kopari

I must first say I was gifted but I am in love with this product .. so I was gifted by kopari !!! I have been up and down on this brand but love this .. even bringing it with me on vacation ... I am almost 40
